summary: Independent review of the seed-cap release on fresh SELL segments — the fix for the #933 regression that cost TNON a 55 percent move on 2026-09-11. THE DEFECT, FOUND IN THE SOURCE AND ONE LINE LONG: on a SELL flip the code resets cw_entries_this_flip UNCONDITIONALLY but clears the composition latches only inside 'if not self._flip_owned_first_entry_enabled'. With RECLAIM1 enabled in production nothing cleared them, so the 06:51 seed cap's cw_resting_taken survived the 08:55 genuine SELL and the 08:58 placement was suppressed as first_slot_already_consumed. TNON ran 5.33 to 8.29 with no order all day. THE REPLAY PROOF — I RAN IT MYSELF WITH CODEX'S OWN COMMAND rather than accepting the PR's result: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python scripts/replay_v2_seed_cap_incident.py TNON 2026-09-11. It reads 669 REAL bars from strategy_bar_history and takes its settings from /proc/646497/environ, the LIVE process environment rather than code defaults. UNFIXED: cap=1 sell_bar=08:55ET decision=08:58ET action=suppressed level=8.5437 with the exact V2-RESTING-SLOT-CONSUMED reason=first_slot_already_consumed marker. FIXED: same cap, same sell bar, same decision bar, action=placed at the same level with V2-RESTING-EH-ARM. Both halves on the real tape, and the unfixed half proves the control can come out false. THE FIX COVERS EVERY COMBINATION — I walked the matrix rather than the diff: flag off clears at the original site; flag on with an idle owner and no evidence clears via the new path; flag on with an idle owner that HAS evidence fails closed to unknown; flag on in any other phase while flat clears through retirement; flag on with an open position correctly does NOT clear. Routing both the retire path and the new path through a single _clear_cw_slot_claims helper is the right call — the absence of that pairing is what caused this regression. REBASE INTEGRITY: source is byte-identical to the d48d74f I reviewed except one legitimate addition, the probe line gaining resting_below_floor_bars from the merged #960. The remaining growth is the captured TNON tape fixture, which is the point of the PR. MUTATIONS on this exact head, all RED: reinstate the #933 bug so an idle SELL no longer clears; clear despite contradictory owner evidence; clear the resting latch only and not reclaim. Controlled full unit pair vs base e1fd332d: base 46 failed / 3706 passed, head 46 failed / 3710 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed. Ruff clean. Ancestor PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. METHOD CORRECTION RECORDED: my first head-suite run reported 75 failures. That was MY error — I ran the mutation matrix and the full suite CONCURRENTLY IN THE SAME WORKTREE, so mutations rewrote the module while pytest imported it. The worktree verified clean afterwards and the isolated re-run gave 46/3710. A mutation matrix and a full suite must never share a worktree. No findings; nothing withheld.
